dog.description_text:
There’s a mystery that needs solving: Who will be Sherlock’s forever family?

This handsome seven-month-old black kitten is ready to investigate the case of his missing forever home. He may be young, but Sherlock is already an expert at uncovering the important things in life—where the treats are, which toys are the most fun, and exactly where the best napping spots can be found.

If you’re looking for a charming companion to join you on life’s next great adventure, Sherlock is ready to crack the case!
